## The heuristic

**In most markets the incumbent is a spreadsheet and somebody's Tuesday afternoon. Put status quo on the competitor map by name.
**


_Why:_ Leave it off and every win-rate and reachable-share estimate is wrong in the same direction, because the largest holder of the budget is missing from the model. It also changes the pitch: displacing a habit needs a trigger and a cost of inaction, while displacing a vendor needs a difference.
